reset_data.title: Clear data & cache
reset_data.description: Removes all stored data — learned consumption profile, price archive, distribution-tariff snapshots and optimizer simulations — and reloads the integration. Your configuration (sensors, battery, tariffs, prices) is kept. Use this if old data seems to be interfering after configuration changes.

hierarchy.title: Hierarchia liczników
hierarchy.description: Dla każdego czujnika urządzenia wskaż licznik nadrzędny, w którym już się zawiera. „Główny” = bezpośrednio pod głównym czujnikiem zużycia (np. wyjście Victron). Przykład: pralka zawiera się w mieszkaniu, a mieszkanie w wyjściu Victron. Dzięki temu każda kWh liczona jest tylko raz, bez duplikacji. {info}

tariff_form.title: Tariff ({mode})
tariff_form.description: Editing: {name}. The base component is added to every period's price. VAT is applied multiplicatively to the distribution price (base + period). Energy price has its own VAT in the prices section. Configure validity ranges and periods in the next steps.

data.name: Tariff name (e.g. Tauron G12)
data.base_component_kwh: Base component added to every hour (PLN/kWh, net)
data.vat_rate: VAT applied to the distribution price (0.23 = 23%)

period_list.title: Periods of {tariff_name}
period_list.description: Tariff: **{tariff_name}** · base component {base_component} PLN/kWh · {count} periods. Periods are evaluated in order — first match wins. Add a catch-all "Pozaszczyt" period covering hours 0–24 without a day classifier.

period_form.title: Period ({mode}) in {tariff_name}
period_form.description: Hour range is half-open: [from, to). For a night band crossing midnight (e.g. 22→6) set from=22 to=6. For future days a referenced workday sensor is resolved via the `workday.check_date` service.

range_list.title: Validity ranges of {tariff_name}
range_list.description: Tariff: **{tariff_name}** · {count} ranges. Add as many ranges as you need (e.g. winter 2024/25 + winter 2025/26). With no ranges the tariff is always active.

range_form.title: Validity range ({mode}) for {tariff_name}
range_form.description: Both dates are optional and inclusive. Leave a date blank for open-ended.

data.charge_efficiency_curve_text: Charge efficiency curve — "power:efficiency%" pairs, e.g. "500:80, 1000:91, 2500:93, 5000:91" (power in W or kW; empty = flat efficiency)

billing.title: PowerPilot – price cap (Tarcza)
billing.description: The seller caps the MONTHLY weighted-average energy price: at month end you pay min(cost, limit × kWh) per point of delivery — a settlement over the whole month, not an hourly cap. Each edition of the terms has its own validity, limit and basis; months no edition covers have no cap. Editions configured: {count}.

billing_terms.title: PowerPilot – price cap edition
billing_terms.description: Dates must span whole months (from the 1st to the last day) and may not overlap another edition. Excise and distribution are always outside the cap. A net limit is grossed up with the VAT from the price settings.

data.name: Name (e.g. Tarcza Pstryk 2026)
data.valid_from: Valid from (first day of a month)
data.valid_to: Valid to (last day of a month)
data.limit_includes_vat: The limit includes VAT (gross) — off: the limit is net
data.handling_fee_included: The handling fee counts in the average (energy + handling fee) — off: energy only

billing_meters.title: PowerPilot – PPE 1 import meters
billing_meters.description: Meters (kWh) whose SUM is the grid import of PPE 1. Every load on that connection must be covered — an hour missing from any of them is unknown, never zero.

data.ppe1_import_sensors: PPE 1 grid-import meters (e.g. inverter AC-in to AC-out, AC-in to inverter, EV charger meter)

supply.title: PowerPilot – apartment supply
supply.description: Tells whether the apartment is fed from the Victron (PPE 1) or from the second meter (PPE 2), from power alone. When the apartment draws at least the minimum power, it is on the Victron if the Victron output minus the other sub-meters behind it covers the apartment within the margin. A change counts after that many agreeing samples in a row (one every 30 s). Detection is on only when the apartment sensor, the Victron output sensor and the other sub-meters are all set; leave all three empty to turn it off.

data.apartment_meter: Metered device that is the apartment (its sub-meters move with it)
data.victron_other_power_sensors: Power of the other sub-meters behind the Victron (outside the apartment)
data.supply_confirm_samples: Agreeing samples in a row to confirm a change

error.invalid_efficiency_curve: Invalid efficiency curve — use comma-separated "power:efficiency%" pairs, e.g. "1000:91, 2500:93"
error.cap_terms_dates_order: The start date is after the end date.
error.cap_terms_whole_months: The period must span whole months: from the 1st of a month to the last day of a month.
error.cap_terms_limit: The limit must be greater than zero.
error.cap_terms_overlap: This period overlaps another price cap edition.
error.supply_incomplete: Set all three: the apartment sensor, the Victron output sensor and at least one other sub-meter behind the Victron — or leave all three empty.
error.supply_sensor_reused: Each sensor can play one role only: the apartment, the Victron output and the other sub-meters must be different sensors.
error.supply_apartment_not_top_level: The apartment meter must sit directly under the main consumption meter (the Meter hierarchy section).

options.per_bucket: Per bucket (energy/distribution/taxes rounded separately — matches most sellers)
options.total: Single total (one gross sum, rounded once)
